title: Planning
boardViewTitle: Switch to the board view with the same filters applied
exportDialogDescription: Choose the dates and items to include. The workbook contains a Summary and a sortable Schedule sheet.
exportDateRangeError: Choose valid start and end dates, with the end date on or after the start date.
exportInvalidFilters: Some filters are invalid. Return to Planning, review the selected filters, and try again.
exportAllItems: Include every item in the date range
exportNoActiveFilters: No filters are active. All items in the selected dates will be included.
exportTooManyItems: This range includes more than 25,000 items. Narrow the dates or apply filters, then try again.
emptyFilterDescription: No items match {filter}. Try clearing the filter to see everything planned for this month.
emptyNothingDescription: Create an idea to start a draft. You can add the brief, assets, and publishing setup as it moves through the workflow.
emptyNothingDescriptionReadOnly: Content will appear here when a workspace manager or content planner adds the first draft.
outOfRangeTitle: Page {page} is past the end of the list
outOfRangeDescriptionOne: The current filters match {count} item across {pages} page. Jump back to the first page to keep browsing.

noAtRiskTitle: No at-risk items on this page
noAtRiskDescription: The at-risk filter only shows items that are overdue and still in flight. Try the next page, or clear the filter to see everything.
editAccessDeniedDescription: Only workspace managers and content planners can edit ideas.
frozenStatusTitle: This idea can no longer be edited
frozenStatusDescription: It is currently in {status} — once an idea moves past draft / changes requested, its title, format, schedule and channels are frozen so reviewers can rely on them.
editIdeaDescription: Make changes to a draft or changes-requested idea.
